senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Korah, leader of a rebellion against Moses.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 13:9">Tosef. Snh. XIII, 9</cite> <he>ק׳ ועדתו וכ׳</he> Korah and his followers have no share in the world to come; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:13">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>עדת ק׳ וכ׳</he> the followers of K. have &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ שנעשה קרחה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>שעשה</he>) he is named Korah (Bald), because baldness (depopulation) was created in Israel; a. v. fr.
